{{Top|leg}}
A '''clearinghouse''' was a type of base used by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Clearinghouses were typically used to sell stolen goods or sell crewmembers captured during pirate raids into slavery. [[Aral tukor Viest]] possessed a [[Aral tukor Viest's clearinghouse|clearinghouse]] in the [[Far Xandil sector/Legends|Far Xandil sector]].
